Case: Patient D is a 77-year-old Hispanic woman with history of lung cancer who presents with 3 months of diffuse back pain and progressive, unintentional weight loss. In addition to increasing pain, she endorses progressive diffuse weakness, and she now to requires a front-wheel-walker to ambulate.
